title: Bob's Neoserver mods
description: A modpack containing the mods required to play on my server, mostly create mod + addons with the addition of adventure and fantasy.
body:
A "tiny" modpack containing the mods required to play on my modded Minecraft server.
The modpack contains mostly create mod + addons, with the addition of adventure and fantasy mods.

You can also use this modpack if you like the mods in it and want a half stable modpack. I do advice adding some performance mods and removing unwanted / unnecessary mods which are included.
